primary_cohort: 7 scheduled scans [last_available_scan-60m,last_available_scan] all clear; no observed fire in preceding120m
cohort_time_basis: only source available<=issue; scan+15m assumed availability, not historical measured publication time
history_missing: missing file or unknown pixel stays unknown; source coverage and observed-fire history retained
target: any confirmed future sampled GK2A fire=1; every scheduled future scan present/clear=0; otherwise -1
transition_interval: last clear scan to first future positive observation; not an ignition/arrival interval; negative lower leads retained
censor_audit: contiguous sampled clear followup stops at first unknown/fire; later clear cannot fill that gap
blind_gap: last available scan to issue is15m; retrospective gap fire audit cannot affect inputs/cohorts
candidate_rule: original current-clear/current-fire-distance<=30km, every20m, original12h event windows; all candidates x1/3/6h retained
context_rule: regenerate existing static and past-only2020/21/22 ISD for all input candidates; never join future-selected v4 feature missingness
original_reference: v4 source immutable; old identity/known label/base34 feature equivalence audited after construction
